failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: After summary_1 and summary_2 both concluded 'The claim is fully verifiable' and 'No missing evidence documents are identified', the coordinator generated queries stating 'No additional query needed' and 'No query is needed' yet retrieval events still executed. Hop 2 returned the same 7 documents as hop 1 (Geoffrey Chaucer, John Feckenham, List of Westminster Abbey organists, Close of the Collegiate Church of St Peter, John Skelton, Westminster Abbey, Poets' Corner). Hop 3 retrieved entirely irrelevant documents about cherry picking, training needs analysis, merchant plug-ins, etc., indicating the coordinator failed to advance the retrieval strategy despite claiming verification was complete.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents completely irrelevant to the Westminster Abbey claim: 'Cherry picking', 'Training needs analysis', 'Needs assessment', 'Longevity claims', 'Merchant plug-in', 'Dispositive motion', 'Demand signal repository', 'Verification (audit)', 'Data stream management system', 'Third-party verification'. The system continued processing through all three hops despite the solver determining after hop 1 that 'No missing evidence documents are identified' and 'All entities referenced in the claim have sufficient supporting passages.'

failure_modes.name: Repetitive_Output_Loop
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'The claim is fully verifiable through the provided passages. All three assertions are supported... No missing evidence documents are identified.' Summary_2 repeats nearly identically: 'The claim can be fully verified with the provided passages. All three assertions are explicitly confirmed... No additional passages or missing evidence documents are needed.' Both coordinator responses then echo: 'No additional query needed' (hop 2) and 'No query is needed' (hop 3), circularly restating verification is complete without progressing the task.
